about: Request header shapes as they reach the service behind Railway's edge, on each path (docs/cutover/edge-check.md). Client addresses are replaced by RFC 5737 addresses: 203.0.113.0/24 = the real client, 192.0.2.66 = a value the client forged, 198.51.100.0/24 = a Cloudflare egress, 192.0.2.200 = Railway's edge. apps/auth's public-listener tests and apps/api's getRealIp tests read this file. PROVISIONAL: the shapes are as reported by a sibling Railway deployment behind Cloudflare (kidscanspell apps/auth, its issue 332). The phase 13 staging measurement replaces them with the shapes measured on our own staging hostnames, via Cloudflare and direct.
source: kidscanspell issue 332 (reported, not yet measured here)
